prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents our client in connection with the parking lot collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Kindly provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault party, along with a copy of the declarations page for each. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including the claim file, adjuster notes, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any surveillance or parking lot video in your possession. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained. Our client is still receiving medical treatment, and we will forward documentation of injuries and related expenses once it is available. We look forward to your prompt written response.
